label: Muzzle depth

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #4 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: rostrum depth / L: 0.20 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.10 -> -100 = 0.10, +100 = 0.30 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.20) / 0.10)

region.mask_rule: rostrum block, vertical scale about the palatal line; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Vertical depth of the rostrum as a fraction of L (lion +30 deepest, cat -25 shallowest). Distinct from the profile family: this is the rostrum's own depth, not where anything sits vertically (spec section 5). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
